tldr: Dense counterfactual covariance: a certified partial frontier. On the exact bounded-coordinate intervention class, with unknown cell masses and propensities and the stated directional third-moment restriction, we prove \(c r_-\le R_3\le\sup_P\mathbb E\|\widetilde\Sigma-\Sigma(P)\|_{\mathrm{op}}^2\le\min\{E_{\mathrm F},E_+\}\le C r_+\). The public selector is total, uses the original records, and is spectrally bounded between \(I_p/2\) and \(2I_p\) at every configuration. The lower and upper guarantees match on the stated polynomial regime and on \(p\ge n\) or \(a(n,d)\ge1\). A concrete growing sequence separates the global envelopes. The common factorial-score continuation, matching all-regime frontier, and unrestricted consistency boundary remain open.
gap: Published counterfactual covariance results use nuisance-rate conditions at fixed outcome dimension. Direct iid weak-moment covariance results do not supply concentration or testing bounds for estimated common discrete causal scores. The active internal donor retains a subGaussian envelope and leaves its dense continuation unresolved.
fill: The retained question derives a numerical all-regime risk frontier and a finite attaining procedure from the shared-score process, with matching original-joint lower alternatives.
